preservation_requirements: BeerJSON source format and document version
strict_unknown_field_policy: A document that violates the pinned BeerJSON schemas is outside the strict BeerJSON 1.0 compatibility guarantee. A pragmatic importer MAY preserve nonstandard fields opaquely but MUST report that the source is nonconforming.
lossless_definition: Preservation of all BeerJSON-defined information and semantics, not byte-for-byte JSON reproduction.
claim_status: No FermentationJSON implementation may claim completed BeerJSON 1.0 compatibility from this baseline alone. Representative measurable/range behavior is covered, but concrete domain mappings, complete-document import fixtures, identifier/reference preservation, and complete-document round-trip tests remain required.
